decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing cards that prevent opponent's threats, gain life, and generate card advantage. It aims to stall the game with removal spells and enchantments while generating value through cards like Elspeth, Storm's Herald and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The key strategy is to outlast the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with powerful threats like Beza, the Bounding Spring and United Battlefront. The mana base is designed to support the control game plan with utility lands and efficient mana production.

This aggro Jund deck focuses on using Sacrifice synergy to overwhelm the opponent with constant damage and disruption. By repeatedly sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester using cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the deck can generate value and chip away at the opponent's life total. Mayhem Devil and Ygra, Eater of All provide additional payoff for sacrificing creatures, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn help control the board. The deck's mana base includes a mix of lands to support its multicolor requirements.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly generate value through sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil. It also utilizes cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute to disrupt opponents' strategies and gain advantage. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and control the pace of the game with removal spells like Fatal Push. The inclusion of lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provides extra utility and flexibility in combat situations. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive plays and resource management.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. With cards like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike for direct damage, as well as creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to apply pressure on the opponent, this deck aims to finish the game fast by dealing damage efficiently. The inclusion of versatile lands like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear adds flexibility to the deck's strategy, while cards like Tersa Lightshatter and Monstrous Rage provide additional ways to push through damage and secure victory.

This Arclight Phoenix aggro deck focuses on quickly casting cheap spells to trigger abilities that can bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, allowing for repeated attacks and high damage output. The deck includes a mix of instant and sorcery spells, as well as cards that enable card draw and mana fixing to keep the aggression going. Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional support for the aggressive strategy, while Picklock Prankster and Cori-Steel Cutter offer ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, while also drawing cards and playing disruptively with counterspells and removal. The key strategy is to efficiently cycle through the deck, enabling the quick and repeated return of Arclight Phoenix to attack the opponent. The deck is built to be aggressive and disruptive, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of spells, creatures, and control elements. It requires careful planning and resource management to maximize the potential of Arclight Phoenix and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main concept of this Lotus Field combo deck is to generate mana advantage by using Lotus Field, Thespian's Stage, and Hidden Strings to ramp up quickly and cast big spells like Dig Through Time and Otawara, Soaring City. The deck focuses on card selection, manipulation, and digging through the library efficiently to find the combo pieces needed for explosive plays. Utilizing Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field and Expedition Map to find additional lands are key strategies to ensure smooth gameplay and maximize the deck's potential.

The deck focuses on using a combination of disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize and efficient removal like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the opponent's board and hand. Cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse help control the game by generating value or recurring threats. The deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and close out the game with cards like Castle Locthwain and Blade of the Oni. The mono black control archetype aims to grind out the opponent and control the game until it can secure a win.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards to help find and protect the combo pieces, as well as disruption and removal to control the game until the combo can be assembled. The strategy revolves around setting up the combo while managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure victory through overwhelming board presence and synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play Spirit creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The Spirits benefit from each other's presence on the battlefield, increasing their power and making them difficult to deal with. By playing a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to maintain control of the board while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly equipping creatures with powerful auras to create a fast and aggressive board presence. By utilizing a mix of auras and creature buffs, it aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The key strategy is to flood the board with creatures and quickly enchant them with auras like Ethereal Armor and All That Glitters to create massive threats. The inclusion of support cards like Gryff's Boon and Sentinel's Eyes helps to protect the creatures and keep the pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play Arclight Phoenix and employ spells and abilities to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries, enabling the Phoenix to be brought back from the graveyard repeatedly. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace by casting low-cost spells and utilizing card draw and selection to ensure a steady stream of spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability. The inclusion of disruptive spells and versatile creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter and Picklock Prankster adds to the deck's flexibility and ability to control the game.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board presence and card advantage. By utilizing a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, along with disruptive creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Gifted Aetherborn, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and win conditions like Blade of the Oni and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional ways to close out the game. The deck also includes hand disruption and land destruction to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and card draw to fill the graveyard with spells, ultimately enabling the reanimation of Arclight Phoenix for repeated aggressive attacks. With a mix of efficient removal spells and card selection tools, the deck aims to quickly generate threats and overwhelm opponents before they can establish their own game plan. The key strategy is to consistently recur Arclight Phoenix while disrupting the opponent's board presence, leading to a proactive and fast-paced play style.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's hand and board with cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Fatal Push while also developing your own board presence with a mix of versatile creatures and powerful planeswalkers. The goal is to control the game early on and deal damage quickly, pressuring your opponent and forcing them to react to your threats. With a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to stay ahead of the curve and dictate the pace of the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay with a mix of burn and creature cards to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With a low mana curve and plenty of direct damage spells, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent early on and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage alongside powerful burn spells like Lightning Helix and Boros Charm, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the start and maintain control until victory is achieved.
